method: All three judges scored each of 180 randomly-sampled responses (25% of 720 total) using the rubric from Section 3.2 of the main paper. Cohen's kappa pairwise + Fleiss' kappa across the three.

ranking_stability.metric: Kendall tau on the 9-model Total Reflexivity Score ranking

per_judge_bias_test.method: 10000-sample permutation test for systematic favouritism (does Claude judge over-score Claude model?)
per_judge_bias_test.decision: Not significant at alpha=0.05; we replace Claude judge with DeepSeek-R1 judge for the Claude Opus model row in Table 3 to fully eliminate this concern; the result changes by <0.02 score points.
